summary: Tested MCP server, Claude integration, payment updates, Schedule A, and mobile fixes. All 15 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified via screenshots and Playwright automation.
critical_code_review_comments: MCP URL generation in generate-key uses FRONTEND_URL.replace('3000','8001') which is fragile. In production the frontend/backend URLs may differ in domain, not port. Should use a dedicated BACKEND_URL env var instead.
seed_data_creation: MCP test proposals created (TEST_ prefixed notes) - approved/rejected during testing
